items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48358 (unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via webhooks) and CVE-2026-48356 (unrestricted file upload). Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: This denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component and can be triggered remotely without authentication. Successful exploitation can crash the application, disrupting storefront and administrative availability.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Adobe has released Magento 2.4.9 with a fix, but older supported versions remain vulnerable.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and access store data. Six of the 19 CVEs included are rated Critical, with one being a CVSS 8.7 stored XSS flaw.
